raw_snippet: 2 nm family capacity growth will be growing at around 70% CAGR from 2026 to 2028
note: TSMC's second-quarter 2026 call. Its planned yearly growth in 2nm-family wafer capacity from 2026 to 2028: its newest node, not all leading-edge logic, which the same slide put at a quarter a year for 3nm and 5nm.
